infobox.usage: Unlocks room 204 in the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 204 key (Dorm 204) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "204" on it.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- Warehouse #3 at the shipping yard: In the brown jacket that is located at the industrial shelf

- In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One blue standing weapons locker/Safe combo
- Loose loot
